thesis: PLMR is a good company bought at the wrong moment. It is overbought (RSI 74, about 9% above the SMA20) and 1% under its 52-week high, with only about 2.6% upside to the mean analyst target and a modest 1.96 R/R. The market is in a high-confidence risk-off regime (QQQ under its 50/200-day averages, VIX at the 99th percentile), and extended leaders are the first to be sold when correlations spike. An undated New York investor day could land inside the swing window, and a follow-on offering is a typical move after a run to highs. A pullback to the SMA20 area would cost the full stop distance, while the setup offers little room above.
